Fastest times:- M.Freary (Bolton) 21:27(rec), J.Jackson (Nth.Staffs.) 21:51, R.Hill (Bolton) 21:53, J.Taylor(Cov.God)21:54, Gerry North (BELS) 21:57.
In addition,there is every chance that their cross country internationals Juan Taylor (only once outside the'teens in the last four Nationals) and John Hammond will be well to the fore.

John Thresher took the stage out of Weston with a gap of 60 secs between himself and fourth place and although he had to give away 3 secs to Juan Taylor running for Coventry in the lead he was able to whittle away some of the other clubs' lead although remaining in 5th place.
Since previous fast times on this course have been run by Kilby, Juan & Dick Taylor, Adcocks and Tim Johnston, this run of Gerry's is indicative of his present excellent form.
